Une délégation de neuf étudiants algérie: A delegation of nine Algerian students, from the country's top schools and universities, left Algiers this Friday evening for Shenzhen (China) to represent Algeria at the 2025/2026 edition of the prestigious Huawei ICT Competition. Driven by six years of Algerian dominance in this competition, the national talents, divided into three teams (Computing, Cloud, and Network), will challenge the world's best competitors in a rapidly changing technological ecosystem.
Shenzhen, capitale mondiale de l'innovat: Shenzhen, the global capital of technological innovation, is hosting this year's Huawei ICT Competition, an annual event that highlights the skills of young talents in information and communication technologies (ICT).
L'Algérie, déjà sacrée six fois consécut: Algeria, already crowned six consecutive times, is sending a delegation of nine students, selected from the country's most prestigious institutions. This performance comes at a time when the Algerian telecom sector, dominated by operators Mobilis, Djezzy, and Ooredoo, is experiencing accelerated digital transformation. Skills in cloud computing, networking, and artificial intelligence, the competition's flagship disciplines, have become strategic pillars for the Algerian digital economy.

La participation à la Huawei ICT Competi: Participation in the Huawei ICT Competition is part of a broader momentum to strengthen ICT skills in Algeria. The country, which is banking on the digitalization of its economy, has seen its telecom operators invest heavily in 4G and 5G infrastructures, with progressive rollouts in major cities. Mobilis, a subsidiary of Algérie Télécom, for example, launched 5G offerings in 2023, while Djezzy and Ooredoo are accelerating their modernization projects.
Par ailleurs, l'Algérie compte sur ses j: Furthermore, Algeria is relying on its young talent to meet the growing needs in cybersecurity, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence, sectors where international competition is fierce. The Algerian victory in 2024, as in the previous six editions, has reinforced the country's credibility on the African and global tech scene.
La Huawei ICT Competition, organisée par: The Huawei ICT Competition, organized by the Chinese telecoms giant, is one of the most prestigious in the world in the field of ICT. The tests, which combine theory and practice, assess participants' skills in programming, system administration, networking, and the cloud. For the 2025/2026 edition, the challenges are expected to incorporate issues related to generative AI, edge computing, and the sustainability of digital infrastructure.
Les étudiants algériens, conscients de l: Aware of what is at stake, Algerian students underwent intensive training to prepare for the tests. Their goal: perpetuate Algerian excellence and bring home a new title to Algiers, thereby consolidating the country's reputation as a breeding ground for ICT talent.
Le ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur: The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, as well as the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, praised this initiative and expressed their support for the delegation. Kamel Baddari, Minister of Posts and Telecommunications, reaffirmed Algeria's commitment to promoting innovation and training in advanced technologies.
